summary.content:
Today's selection covers 76 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 43 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: What to Know About Recent A.I. Hacks
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Cybercriminals Are Hiding New Malware in Torrents for Popular Films
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, Dark Reading, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 49 articles published in the last 24 hours
